onset.Description: Time of the stimulus onset in seconds relative to the beginning of the experiment t=0.

duration.Description: Duration of the stimulus presentation in seconds.

trial_type.Description: The condition of the stimulus being presented in a given block

Levels.belief: Scenarios and questions in which the participant is asked to think about the mental state of a person in the story.
Levels.photo: Scenarios and questions in which the participant is asked to report facts presented in the story.

response.Description: Button code recorded for questions presented to encourage participants to attend to the stimuli. Responses were not used in the reported analyses and may be missing or incomplete because of response-recording issues.
